questions.question_text: Āpaṇā satsangī sarvene to em ja nishchay karvo je, 'Āpaṇe paṇ e aksharrūp je mukta temnī panktimā bhaḷvu chhe ane Akshardhāmmā jaīne akhand Bhagwānnī sevāmā hajūr rahevu chhe, paṇ ________ ne tuchchha evu je māyik sukh tene ichchhvu nathī ne emā koī ṭhekāṇe lobhāvu nathī;' evo dṛuḍh nishchay rākhīne nirantar Bhagwānnī ekāntik bhakti karvī.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Pr.21, one should resolve to not desire perishable and trivial worldly pleasures.

questions.question_text: Ā pṛuthvī jenī rākhī sthir rahī chhe ne ḍolāvī ḍole chhe tathā ā tārāmanḍaḷ jenu rākhyu adhar rahyu chhe tathā jenā varsāvyā megh varshe chhe tathā jenī āgnāe karīne ________ uday-astapaṇāne pāme chhe...evā anant āshcharya chhe te sarve mane maḷyā evā je Bhagwān tenā karyā ja thāy chhe,' em samaje, paṇ pragaṭ pramāṇ je Bhagwān te vinā bījo koī e āshcharyano karnāro chhe em māne nahī.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Pr.27, the sun and moon rise and set by His command.

questions.question_text: Jene māhātmya sahit nishchay hoy tene to em samjāy je, "Je divase Bhagwānnu darshan thayu te divasthī ja ________ to thaī rahyu chhe. Ane je jīv bhāve karīne māru darshan kare tathā māru vachan māne tenu paṇ kalyāṇ thaī jāy, to mārā kalyāṇno shyo sanshay chhe. Hu to kṛutārtha chhu ane je kāī sādhan karu chhu te to Bhagwānnī prasannatāne arthe karu chhu." Em samaje tene Bhagwānno māhātmya sahit nishchay jāṇvo.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Pr.72, Kalyan (deliverance) begins from the day one has Bhagwān's darshan.

questions.question_text: Atishay je moṭāpurush hoy teno je upar rājīpo thāy tenā game tevā malin sanskār hoy to ________ ane moṭāpurushno rājīpo thayo hoy to rānk hoy te rājā thāy ane game tevā bhūnḍā prārabdha hoy to rūḍā thāy ane game tevu tene māthe vighna āvnāru hoy te nāsh thaī jāy.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Pr.58, any tainted impressions are destroyed when a great devotee is pleased.

questions.question_text: Hamaṇā jaṇātu nathī, paṇ āpaṇne Bhagwān maḷyā chhe māṭe ________ thayā chhīe.
questions.explanation: According to Swa. Vato: 4/9, we have become fulfilled because we have attained Bhagwān.

questions.question_text: Moṭāno rājīpo hoy tenā antarmā sukh vartyā kare ne dehmā to sukh-duhkha āve, teno to nirdhār nahi, bākī tene din-din pratye ________ vṛuddhi pāmtī jāy, ne dahāḍe dahāḍe vadhto jāy, em varte tyāre em jāṇvu je, "Moṭā rājī chhe."
questions.explanation: According to Swa. Vato: 2/176, faith increases day by day when the great one is pleased.

questions.question_text: Moṭāno rājīpo thayā vinā ________ ṭaḷe nahi.
questions.explanation: According to Swa. Vato: 4/24, the seed of desires cannot be removed without the pleasure of the great one.

questions.question_text: Āj ānand mārā urmā, maḷī mune mahā monghī vāt re; ________ kare Hari nav maḷe, te to mune maḷiyā sākshāt re... Āj...
questions.explanation: According to the Kirtan by Nishkuḷānand Swami, even millions of hardships cannot attain Hari, but I have attained Him directly.

questions.question_text: Sukh sukh sukh jyā sukh ghaṇu, te to mukhe kahetā nā kahevāy re; Nishkuḷānand e ________, harkhī harkhī guṇ gāy re... Āj...
questions.explanation: According to the Kirtan by Nishkuḷānand Swami, Nishkulanand sings the praises while rejoicing in that bliss.

questions.question_text: Bhagwānnī prasannatāne arthe karu chhu." Em samaje tene Bhagwānno ________ jāṇvo.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Pr.72, one who understands this has realization along with the greatness of Bhagwān.
